field_under_test.semantic_identity: radio (BCM2069) revision class = radio_rev >> 4, i.e. the high nibble of the 2069 revision register byte
field_under_test.not: 'radio revision' as a standalone free variable
field_under_test.value_domain_observed: 0,1,2 (0 for rev 0..15; 1 for rev 16..31; 2 for rev 32..47; 15 for the rev254 special)

producer.window_selector_register: 0x3d8 (radio indirect address latch); 0x3da = radio indirect data (16-bit)

window_gate.condition: uses 0x3d8/0x3da when NOT (hw+0x28 == 0x1B || hw+0x28 <= 0x17); otherwise reads 0x3f6/0x3f8/0x3fa
window_gate.board_value: AGENTS-state D11 rev 0x2A / 42 (>0x17, !=0x1B) => 0x3d8/0x3da confirmed on this board
window_gate.confidence: C1 (board value from hardware-proven M2.5/M3.4D3A1; exact struct field name not recovered)

radio_rev_register_evidence: sub_9fb72 @0x9fc89 compares pi+0x16a to 0x2069; @0x9fc92 loads pi+0x16c (R) and indexes a rev jump table with (R-3), range R in [3,38]
wlc_phy_radio_override_acphy branches on pi+0x16e == 2 / == 0 and (implicitly) rev1
wlc_phy_attach_acphy OTP fallback: pi+0x16e == 2 -> hw+0xF2=9; pi+0x16e == 1 -> hw+0xF2=0x0A

overwrite_behavior.radio_reg0_writes_anywhere: only sub_10a6a0 @0x10a6dc (write_radio_reg reg 0x0) - a non-AC (>=0x100000) path; radio reg 0 is hardware identity on the AC path
overwrite_behavior.conclusion: not overwritten on the AC operational path

initialization_order: phytype/phyrev read from PHY reg 0x3e0 -> pi+0x160 (phytype), pi+0x164 (phyrev), pi+0x174 (0x3e0>>12)
radio reg 0 + reg 1 read through 0x3d8/0x3da -> pi+0x16a/16c/16e/16f
radio-id/revision validation vs accepted set {0x30B,0x2069}; mismatch -> wlc_phy_switch_radio(pi,0) then attach error path

consumers.predicate: al == 1 -> sequence A; al == 2 -> sequence B; else skip both
consumers.purpose: radio analog/synth enable sequence selection (PLL lock)

consumers.predicate: ==2 uses ovr_regs_2069_rev32 table + per-chain loop; ==1 uses ovr_regs_2069_rev2; ==0 uses ovr_regs_2069_rev16
reads pi+0x16e to pick spur mode family

A.radio_regs: 0x80b (chip-id gated BCM4352), 0x97f, 0x8ea; osl_delay(100); lock poll read_radio_reg(0x80b)&1 <= 0x65 iters x100us

proven_statically: the selector is read from radio reg 0 bits[11:4] (hardware), not set by any board field
the A/B/skip mapping to selector values
the 2069 revision-class model (rev>>4) and the per-class consumers
static_closure.not_provable_statically: the numeric 2069 revision of this board's radio, hence the executed branch
static_closure.why: radio reg 0 is read-only identity; no NVRAM/SPROM/chipstatic override exists (no 'radiorev'/'radioid' NVRAM var; the only radio-reg0 writer is a non-AC >=0x100000 path)

hardware_fact_still_required: read radio reg 0 (0x3d8=0 -> 0x3da) and radio reg 1 (0x3d8=1 -> 0x3da) on the BCM4352 board; selector = (reg0 >> 4) & 0xff; rev = reg0 & 0xff

read_only_probe_design.status: DESIGN ONLY - NOT IMPLEMENTED, NOT EXECUTED
read_only_probe_design.phybase: pi+0x148 (mapped PHY/radio window base; == D11 core reg window base + PHY offset used by osl_readw/osl_writew)
read_only_probe_design.prerequisite_state: D11 core enabled + PHY/radio clock running; earliest already-proven safe point on the isolated path is after the D2B common-initvals exit (M3.4D2B) or the D3A1 tail; the vendor reads it at probe (wlc_phy_attach) after core reset
read_only_probe_design.window_selector_is_a_write: YES - the 0x3d8 address-latch write is unavoidable to select the radio register; it is the exact operation read_radio_reg performs and does not change radio configuration (address latch only). If a strictly write-free observation is required, it is IMPOSSIBLE: the 0x3da data port is only meaningful for the latched register.
read_only_probe_design.dev_lost_integration: OB_GUARD: use ob_d11_read16/ob_d11_write16 (pi+0x148==hw->core window) so a latched device returns OB_GUARD_DEAD16 and no MMIO follows; a 0xffff/0xffff pair must be treated as device-lost, not as a revision
read_only_probe_design.expected_raw_result: v0 (u16), v1 (u16); rev = v0 & 0xff; selector = (v0 >> 4) & 0xff; radio id = v1
read_only_probe_design.bounded: 2 writes + 2 reads, no polling, no state change beyond the address latch

new_blockers.summary: Exact executed PLL branch (A/B/skip) requires a read-only radio reg0 read on the BCM4352 board; probe designed, not implemented/executed.

tooling_gaps.desc: re has no cross-function struct-field READER enumeration (re field-writers only lists writers); consumers of pi+0x16e required a whole-.text objdump displacement scan.
re cannot express a hardware-register-bitfield -> object-field provenance chain (radio reg0 bits[11:4] -> pi+0x16e) or a revision decision matrix.
ELF function-boundary disagreement: sub_9fb72 (re, discovered/weak) spans ELF local symbols incl. wlc_phy_set_analog_tx_lpf; overlapping-symbol disambiguation still open (T6 family).
objdump/ELF symbol sizes for large .rodata/.data tables (pll_frac_tbl_rev*, chan_tuning_*, prefregs_*) are st_size-truncated (e.g. 'size=16'); true size requires next-symbol delta.
